intro.title: Welcome to FSC
intro.description: Fly Squash Club is a world-class squash facility located in the heart of Shanghai. We offer top-tier coaching, professional courts, and a vibrant community for players of all levels.

about.title: About Us
about.description: Fly Squash Club is dedicated to promoting squash across China and helping young athletes pursue excellence on court. An experienced coaching team, modern training philosophy, and world-class facilities make us the destination of choice for squash players nationwide.

camp.title: FSC Master Training Camp — Big Reveal
camp.body: International masters return to FSC. Elite Squash's Hadrian Stiff and FSC signed player NG Eain Yow co-lead two exclusive camps. Session 1 · Hongqiao · July 21–25. Session 2 · Longyang · July 27–31. Contact your local instructor to secure a spot.

magazine.title: FSC — Seen because we put in the work
magazine.body: Five years. Three locations. Eleven glass courts. Thank you to Squash Player magazine for shining a light on Shanghai, and on the squash scene growing across China.

tournament.title: 2026 Shanghai Women's Spring Open · A Successful Wrap
tournament.body: The FSC Women's Spring Open closed in style. Huge thanks to title sponsor Dunlop (＠Dunlop Tennis) — players left with thoughtful gifts and fresh flowers, making the Women's Day weekend on court one to remember.
